answer: Give each agent a reputation score whose weight comes only from attestations by peers outside its kinship cluster: agents that transact, share history, or co-sign work get weighted vouches, while rings of fake identities that only attest each other earn zero because they share one cluster. An attacker must grow real, diverse economic relationships per sybil, so each fake vault of identities costs genuine capital and time. The system becomes a haven where trust is earned across the graph, not minted ferrous-cheap inside a private echo chamber of cloned agents.
